text: ふう…　この　へんで…　…　ひとやすみ　して　いこう　ハナダ　シティから　どうくつを　ぬけて　きたら　…　つかれた

structure.jp: ふう…　この　へんで…　…
ひとやすみ　して　いこう
structure.en: I'll take a short rest before going on

structure.jp: ハナダ　シティから　どうくつを　ぬけて　きたら
structure.en: when I came through the cave from Cerulean City

patterns.name: 〜ていく
patterns.explanation: A て-form verb plus いく says you do that thing and then go on your way. ひとやすみ して いこう = 'I'll take a rest and then go on'.

patterns.name: 〜たら
patterns.explanation: たら on a verb says 'when I did this', and what follows is what turned out. ぬけて きたら … つかれた = 'when I came through, I ended up tired'.

patterns.name: 〜てくる
patterns.explanation: A て-form verb plus くる says the action was done on the way to where the speaker is now. どうくつを ぬけて きた = 'came here through the cave'.
